- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Contract
- **Type:** tooling (corrective for F-008; gap 1 of card 208's runner gaps)
- **Repository:** mob-defaults (C:\Users\ringe\mob-crosscli), not the product repository
- **Source:** finding F-008 through card 208's split. The card's GitHub issue names F-008 as its corrective action; the first line of the issue body reads "Corrective action for F-008 (the task-force parser reads role lines only)". parse_task_force treats every bulleted "Name: ..." line of the Task force section as a role, so bulleting "Left out:" or "Assignee note:" makes check_task_force refuse the card for roles that are not roles. Verified at slice: card 208's own paragraph-form text parses to exactly seven roles; the bulleted form yields two false ones.
- **Depends on:** none
- **Actor:** facilitator.py card mode (parse_task_force, check_task_force, mob_seats, write_record)
- **Given:** a card whose Task force section holds role lines, a Left out list, an assignee note and a domain-expert answer, in paragraphs or in bullets
- **Observes:** only lines of the form "- Role: Model | why: ... | context: ctx-N", and a bullet whose assignee names a model or seat, are roles; the other bullets are ignored by the parser, the seat list and the record
- **Fails with:** a role line missing its why or its context is refused by name as today; a bullet whose assignee names a model but has no why or context is refused, never silently dropped
- **Invariants:** every existing task-force rule (distinct contexts, no facilitator session, mid-card joined and removed with a Decider) is unchanged; paragraph-form notes keep parsing as today
- **Enables:** cards whose notes are bulleted run in the loop; closes F-008's last runner gap
- **One observable behaviour:** Given a Task force section with notes in bullets, card mode seats the declared roles and no others.
- **Done checks (at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Notes are not roles: a Left out, assignee note or domain-expert bullet is not a role, a seat or a record entry. ZOMBIES: Z (no Task force section, no role line: refused as today), O (one role line), M (several roles plus the three notes as bullets), B (a "- Left out: ..." bullet is the only non-role bullet), I (roles listed exactly). N/A: E, S. To be written by QA at ready.
  2. Role lines still refused by name: a role line without why or without context is refused naming the role. ZOMBIES: E (no why, no context, both missing), B (a placeholder assignee), O (one bad role among good ones), I (the refusal names it). N/A: Z, M, S. To be written by QA at ready.
  3. No false pass: a bullet whose assignee names a model or seat but has no why and context (for example "- Backend: Codex") is a role and is refused, not dropped; a note that merely mentions a model inside prose is not a role. ZOMBIES: B (assignee exactly a model name versus a sentence containing one), E (placeholder assignee TBD), M (mixed bullets), I (mob_seats and the record list the same roles). N/A: Z, O, S. To be written by QA at ready.
